title: Tester with reindexed query domain
statement: Given types $\Omega$ and $\Omega'$, a codomain $\beta$, a natural number $r$, a map $e : \Omega \to \Omega'$, and a nonadaptive tester from $\Omega$ to $\beta$, define a tester from $\Omega'$ to $\beta$. It keeps the same random seeds, seed distribution, and acceptance rule, and maps each queried address through $e$, preserving unqueried positions.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a nonadaptive tester from $\Omega$ to $\beta$
